title: Prospective Registry of Acute Coronary Syndromes in Ferrara
official: Acute coRonary sYndrOmes proSpective regisTry Of Ferrara
summary: The ARYOSTO has been designed to describe the clinical epidemiology and the current management of acute coronary syndromes (ACS) in the area of Ferrara. Especially, the Authors will evaluate the medical and interventional management of ACS patients admitted to hospitals in the area of Ferrara and receiving coronary artery angiography and percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) in the hub center of Ferrara (Azienda Ospedaliera Universitaria di Ferrara, Cona (FE), Italy)

interventions.name: prospective collection of data and follow-up

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* age \>18 years
* hospital admission for acute coronary syndromes
* resident in the Ferrara area

Exclusion Criteria:

* none
